headline: MOGUL v11.7 — fix AI oracle popup + tarot cooldown
summary: Bug fixes: the random AI oracle popup was too rare to ever see (1% chance/day, 6-month play-time threshold) — now 3% chance/day with a 30-day threshold (~10 min real time). The Tarot draw button was incorrectly disabled when lastDrawDay=0 (fresh state) — now matches the engine logic: the first draw is always allowed; the 30-day cooldown applies only after the first draw.
features: AI oracle popup: chance raised from 1% to 3% per game-day (avg popup per 33 game-days → 11 game-days)
AI oracle popup: play-time threshold lowered from 180 days to 30 days (~10 min real time, was ~60 min)
Tarot draw button: no longer disabled on fresh state; cooldown only applies after first draw
Version bumped to v11.7 on homepage + version.json
